name: standard push-up
description: A standard floor push-up that strengthens the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands about shoulder-width apart and your toes on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Press through your hands to return to straight arms without letting your hips sag.
